_note: Flat params (RmsCadConsole EvidenceTab.transfer: lensRun('law-enforcement','evidenceTransfer',{evidenceId,to,signature,event,locker})). THE IDENTIFIER DEFINITION (S2(i), closing the contract-definition gap named in cross-check #70(b)): an evidence item carries two identifiers — the display ID (barcode, 'EVD-…'), issued by evidenceIntake and printed on the item's row, and the internal id ('ev_…'), the store key. evidenceId accepts EITHER form: the internal id by exact key, the display ID matched case-insensitively. Before this definition the handler resolved only the internal id, so the display ID the booking hands the user was refused at transfer ('evidence not found'). The not-found error now names both accepted forms. A successful transfer appends one custody entry {event,from,to,locker,signature,at,note}, sets currentHolder=to, and event 'release'/'destroyed' moves status accordingly; evidenceChain applies the same identifier resolution.
name: evidenceTransfer
